edges.reason: setOwner authorizes on msg.sender == owner via only_owner modifier.
upgradeMeAdmin relies on only_admin whose isAdmin check derives from msg.sender.
setAdmin is gated by only_admin using msg.sender.
incAdminEpoch is only_owner and re-grants admin to msg.sender.
reclaimToken is only_owner, authorization from msg.sender.
submitVote passes msg.sender as the vote sender into _addVote.
submitProxyVote uses msg.sender indirectly through BBFarm namespace gating and emits voter.
_addVote stores the sender address, which is msg.sender for direct votes.
dOwnerErc20Claim requires msg.sender to equal the erc20 owner()/controller() result.
_deployBallot forwards msg.sender to _bbFarm.initBallot as the ballot admin.
requireBallotOwner requires msg.sender == db.ballotOwner.
setDOwnerFromClaim is only_editors, derived from msg.sender.
setPermissions is only_admin gated on msg.sender.
requireBallotClosed compares now against the packed end time.
requireBallotOpen compares now against the packed start and end time.
_addVote packs now into castTsAndSender next to the sender.
init uses now for end time validation, start time clamping and creationTs.
_modAccountBalance compares prevPaidTill with now and writes lastPaymentTs.
_accountOkayChecks computes secsToEndTime = endTime - now.
upgradeToPremium converts remaining time relative to now.
downgradeToBasic compares lastUpgradeTs to now - 24 hours.
_basicBallotLimitOperations compares earlyBallotTs to now - 30 days.
tx.origin is an alternative authentication source that must never substitute for msg.sender in ownership checks.
doSafeSendWData performs the low-level value call guarded only by the boolean mutex.
The recipient contract's fallback can re-enter the safeSend caller before txMutex3847834 is reset.
doSafeSendWData reads and writes txMutex3847834 around the external call.
payoutAll sends the full balance through doSafeSend.
payoutAll reads the payout destination from _payTo via _getPayTo.
setOwner writes the owner state variable, changing all future authorizations.
upgradeMeAdmin calls _setAdmin to move admin rights.
setAdmin writes the admins permission mapping.
incAdminEpoch increments the current admin epoch.
The unchecked currAdminEpoch++ is the arithmetic backing the admin epoch rotation.
fwdToENS reads the ENS registry reference before forwarding calldata.
fwdToENS performs an arbitrary low-level call to the ENS registry.
The ENS registry can call back into the proxy during fwdToENS.
fwdToResolver reads the resolver reference before forwarding calldata.
fwdToResolver performs an arbitrary low-level call to the resolver.
The resolver can call back into the proxy contract during fwdToResolver.
submitVote delegates the write to _addVote.
submitVote writes MAX_UINT32 into the sequenceNumber mapping to disable proxies.
submitProxyVote assigns the ecrecover result to the local voter.
The recovered voter address is used as the vote sender in submitProxyVote.
submitProxyVote invokes replay protection for the recovered voter.
_proxyReplayProtection requires and writes the per-voter sequence number.
submitProxyVote records the vote through _addVote with the recovered voter.
_addVote requires the ballot to be open before accepting the vote.
_addVote reads and writes the nVotesCast counter.
The db.nVotesCast += 1 increment is unchecked arithmetic.
_addVote writes voteData, castTsAndSender and extra into the votes mapping.
init validates and stores the ballot specHash.
init stores the ballotOwner used by later owner-gated operations.
init packs submission bits, start and end time into the packed field.
setEndTime re-packs the packed field with the new end time.
newEndTime flows directly into the repacked ballot end time.
revealSeckey is only usable after requireBallotOwner in BBFarm.
requireBallotClosed derives its condition directly from block.timestamp.
requireBallotOpen derives its condition directly from block.timestamp.
requireBallotOwner compares msg.sender against the stored ballot owner.
requireTesting reads the submission bits out of the packed field.
sponsor resolves the ballot database through getDb.
sponsor records the sponsorship before forwarding funds.
sponsor forwards msg.value to the index-controlled payTo through doSafeSend.
logSponsorship pushes a Sponsor record into the sponsors array.
initBallot obtains the storage db through getDb.
initBallot calls the BBLib init function on the resolved db.
initBallot increments the global nBallots counter.
The nBallots += 1 increment is unchecked arithmetic.
getDb indexes the dbs mapping of ballot id to storage.
doUpgrade sets the upgrade pointer before cascading upgrades.
doUpgradeInternal writes the upgrade pointer used by not_upgraded guards.
doUpgrade pushes the nextSC parameter into backend, payments, ENS proxy and bbFarms.
addBBFarm writes the namespace to bbFarm id lookup used to resolve farms.
setABackend can replace the backend reference used for all authorization lookups.
setABackend can replace the payments reference used for accounting.
dOwnerErc20Claim probes the erc20 contract with low-gas low-level calls.
The probed erc20 contract executes arbitrary code inside dOwnerErc20Claim with 3000 gas.
dDeployCommunityBallot receives the ballotId returned by _deployBallot.
dDeployCommunityBallot reads the community ballot price for the fee check.
dDeployCommunityBallot delegates deployment to _deployBallot.
The local ballotId returned from _deployBallot is emitted and used in dDeployCommunityBallot.
_deployBallot rejects deprecated bbFarms via the deprecatedBBFarms mapping.
_deployBallot calls the basic ballot limit logic when checking limits.
_deployBallot calls _accountOkayChecks for paid-up verification.
_deployBallot makes an external call into a registered BBFarm to create the ballot.
The BBFarm initBallot external call can re-enter the index contract mid-deployment.
_basicBallotLimitOperations reads the ballots-per-30-days limit used for gating.
The extra ballot fee path sends value to payments and the sender via doSafeSend.
_accountOkayChecks subtracts now from the ballot end time.
_accountOkayChecks assigns endTime - now to the local secsToEndTime.
The local secsToEndTime drives the require check in _accountOkayChecks.
The endTime - now and secsLeft * 2 arithmetic are unchecked uint operations.
The local secsToEndTime value feeds the unchecked multiplication comparison.
dInit in SVIndex calls the backend to create the democracy.
dInit requires msg.value to be at least the minimum wei for dInit.
dInitBackend asserts prefix uniqueness in democPrefixToHash when adding a democracy.
dInitBackend mixes now into the keccak256 used to generate the democHash.
The democHash parameter is threaded through the SVIndexBackend democracy admin functions.
dAdd writes democPrefixToHash after asserting no prefix collision.
payForDemocracy converts the payment through weiBuysHowManySeconds.
payForDemocracy extends the account balance via _modAccountBalance.
payForDemocracy reads and writes the accounts mapping for premium discounts.
payForDemocracy pushes msg.value to the payout address with transfer.
The local additionalSeconds drives balance modification and payment logging.
upgradeToPremium checks denyPremium before allowing the upgrade.
upgradeToPremium divides remaining time by premiumMultiplier.
upgradeToPremium assigns the remaining time to the local timeRemaining.
The local timeRemaining is divided and re-added into paidUpTill.
The division and timestamp addition during premium conversion are unchecked.
The local timeRemaining feeds the unchecked conversion arithmetic.
downgradeToBasic multiplies remaining time by premiumMultiplier unchecked.
downgradeToBasic reads and writes premium status and paidUpTill in accounts.
setWeiPerCent writes the exchange rate used for all cents conversions.
giveTimeToDemoc extends paid-up time through _modAccountBalance.
emergencySetOwner checks msg.sender against the emergencyAdmin storage slot.
emergencySetOwner overwrites the owner address, bypassing only_owner.
dAddBallotBackend commits the ballot through _commitBallot.
_commitBallot pushes the ballot id into the per-democracy ballot arrays.
PublicResolver.setAddr authorizes on ens.owner(node) == msg.sender.
setAddr writes the address into the records mapping for the node.
setABI writes ABI bytes into the records mapping.
_modAccountBalance writes paidUpTill and lastPaymentTs into accounts.
_modAccountBalance clamps paidUpTill to now when it is in the past.
The prevPaidTill + additionalSeconds timestamp addition is unchecked.
weiBuysHowManySeconds divides by the basic cents price per 30 days.
The SVPayments fallback forwards msg.value to the payout address.
setPermissions writes the editAllowed permission mapping.
isDEditor consults editor and owner permissions derived from the admins/editor mappings.
setDOwnerFromClaim sets the claimed owner as an editor in the democracy mappings.
The amount parameter is forwarded as the value of the low-level external call.
The toAddr parameter is the arbitrary recipient of the low-level value call.
The voteData parameter is stored as the ballot vote payload.
The extra bytes parameter is hashed into the signed message for proxy votes.
The proxyReq array supplies the signature, ballot id and vote for proxy voting.
The ballotId parameter selects the BBLib database being initialized.
The newOwner parameter becomes the owner, controlling all future authorization.
The newAdmin parameter is granted admin rights by upgradeMeAdmin.
The nextSC parameter becomes the upgrade target for the whole system.
The fallback payout path shares the same payout destination with payForDemocracy.

normalization_plan.reason: The ballotId parameter only flows into BBFarm.initBallot and is resolved through getDb.
voteData is a data argument of BBLib.submitVote with no independent security role.
extra is concatenated into the signed message inside BBLib.submitProxyVote.
proxyReq carries the signature, ballot id and vote for BBLib.submitProxyVote.
amount is exactly the value forwarded by the low-level call in doSafeSendWData.
newOwner is written into the owner state variable by setOwner.
newAdmin is the address granted admin rights by upgradeMeAdmin.
toAddr is the arbitrary call target of the doSafeSendWData value call.
voter is the ecrecover result consumed directly by submitProxyVote.
additionalSeconds is the computed credit applied by payForDemocracy.
timeRemaining is the converted value written back by upgradeToPremium.
ballotId is the deployment result used and emitted by dDeployCommunityBallot.
democHash identifies the democracy record written by the SVIndex/SVIndexBackend dInit path.
nextSC is the new implementation address pushed by doUpgrade to all children.
newEndTime is the replacement end time packed by setEndTime.
secsToEndTime is the unchecked endTime - now value used in _accountOkayChecks.
